description: The pie chart, titled "Stimulus Type," displays the distribution of various types of media stimuli, with each segment labeled and its corresponding percentage clearly indicated. The largest segment is "Press Release" at 18.7%, followed closely by "External News Article" at 18.1%. The "Draft/Other" category accounts for 20.1% of the total, making it the largest single category. Other notable segments include "Interview" at 8.8%, "Organizational Report" at 7.7%, and "Event Posting" at 6.6%. Smaller contributions come from "Organizational Website" at 4.9%, "Email" at 2.7%, and "Social Media Post" at 1.1%. The chart uses distinct colors for each category, and the percentages are explicitly labeled next to their respective slices, providing a clear visual representation of the relative proportions of each stimulus type.
